description: Use when an agent must put bytes through a header, a URL or a JSON field, or read what came back: base64 in both directions, including the URL-safe alphabet, with UTF-8 handled properly. x402 itself rides on base64, so this is the one that reads a payment header. Do not use for hashing (/v1/util/sha256) or for hex (/v1/util/hex). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

input.description: The text or base64 to convert.

urlSafe.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet (-_ instead of +/).

name: util_base64
title: Base64 encode and decode
